implementation_origin: independently authored Jai procedures; supplied sources inspected for public contracts only
contract_priority: maintained OpenJai modules first; incompatible older layouts use legacy module names
behavior_status: source implementations present; syntax checked; semantic and runtime behavior unverified

modules.name: Bucket_Array
compatibility_gaps: Returned pointers may move when items grows, as implied by maintained resizable-array storage.
Old two-part locator and stable-address bucket layout require legacy/Bucket_Array.

modules.name: Pool
implemented_behaviors: maintained memblock_size, bytes_left, current_block, and integer current_pos fields
allocator allocation, resize-copy, lifecycle, capability, and ownership modes
compatibility_gaps: pool_allocator_proc is a callable procedure rather than the maintained source's integer intrinsic marker.
Source management fields blocks, active, and block_allocator are appended; exact binary layout is different.
Thread and independent heap allocator modes reject explicitly.
Old configurable pool layout requires legacy/Pool.

modules.name: Flat_Pool
implemented_behaviors: maintained integer position and capacity fields
allocator allocation, resize-copy, lifecycle, capability, and ownership modes
compatibility_gaps: flat_pool_allocator_proc is a callable procedure rather than the maintained source's integer intrinsic marker.
A source backing_allocator field is appended; exact binary layout is different.
Reservation is eager heap memory, not native virtual-page reservation or incremental commitment.
Thread and independent heap allocator modes reject explicitly.
Old pointer-position layout and module parameters require legacy/Flat_Pool.

modules.name: legacy/Bucket_Array
implemented_behaviors: dense forward or reverse iterator indices
compatibility_gaps: Locators have no generation counter; removal followed by reuse intentionally reuses the location.

modules.name: legacy/Pool
implemented_behaviors: reset stamping and optional block freeing
consumed in-band byte and oversized-object counts
allocator allocation, resize-copy, lifecycle, capability, and ownership modes
compatibility_gaps: USE_UNMAPPING_ALLOCATOR=true rejects at compile time; no native unmapping dependency is supplied.
Private Memblock metadata and HEADER_SIZE differ from the supplied implementation.
Thread and independent heap allocator modes reject explicitly.

modules.name: legacy/Flat_Pool
implemented_behaviors: allocator allocation, resize-copy, lifecycle, capability, and ownership modes
compatibility_gaps: Reservation is eager heap memory; first_uncommitted_page equals address_limit because the complete reservation is backed immediately.
A source backing_allocator field is appended; exact binary layout is different.
Thread and independent heap allocator modes reject explicitly.

modules.name: Treemap
implemented_behaviors: dirty revision tracking across multiple displays
compatibility_gaps: Source revision fields are appended to Treemap and Treemap_Display; exact binary layouts differ.
Raw bucket removal and cyclic hierarchy mutation are unsupported; there is no public tree deletion API.
Geometry has not been checked against legacy outputs or a rendered treemap.

modules.name: Soa
implemented_behaviors: default row initialization before first assignment
mutable temporary pointer iteration with writeback
compatibility_gaps: Generated named member arrays such as soa.x are not implemented.
Physical storage uses byte columns plus a written bitmap and does not match the supplied generated record layout.
Union records reject explicitly.

modules.name: Relative_Pointers
implemented_behaviors: range rejection for reserved or unrepresentable displacements
